source_verification_receipts.locator: arXiv abstract; primary TeX source results_main.tex, Theorem 'Non-asymptotics and distributional theory'; analysis.tex, Appendix 'Distributional theory without condition eq:signal-lb', Lemma inference
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a Gaussian approximation and data-driven entrywise CIs under its displayed conditions; after dropping its local signal lower bound, Appendix analysis approximates the error by a variable retaining a bilinear noise term, rather than constructing an all-loading transition-honest CI.

Theorems 4.1--4.2 provide uniformly valid minimum-distance inference under a uniformly asymptotically Gaussian primitive estimator with well-conditioned, consistently estimable covariance; the paper treats product-form degeneracy as an example.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Appendix C, equations (34)--(35b) and the interval display immediately following them
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Appendix C gives a first-order linear Gaussian approximation and plug-in interval for a bilinear hidden-block functional, and says analogous validity follows under modified projected-loading conditions.

The paper verifies enclosures of singular values for R^{-H}AR^{-1}, using computed SVD factors for all singular values or a minimum-singular-value route; it does not address statistical confidence intervals or floating-point propagation through this panel construction.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the numerical target by separating a deterministic exact-dyadic input theorem from the Gaussian statistical experiment, then add an explicit observation-encoding/rounding map and charge its error in Delta_num before asserting P-expectations.

State a precise comparison corollary against Yan--Wainwright's v2 local-signal condition: exhibit sequences allowed by the new class but excluded there, including joint zero, and show the proposed width is order n^{-1} on them.
Promote the upper/lower transition-scale results to a sharp constant or minimax characterization over a clearly stated local submodel, rather than only fixed multiplicative constants.

recommended_next_step: Revise the finite-precision OEQ to reconcile its exact-dyadic execution model with the continuous Gaussian sampling law, then advance the otherwise field-grade statistical kernel.
